title: A full sitting room
setup_text: The baby is home. Relatives want to visit this weekend, but the house is tired and meals are still being worked out.

choices.label: Welcome everyone for a short afternoon
choices.outcome_text: The sitting room filled with greetings and covered dishes. By evening the house was quiet again, with a little less food to cook.

choices.label: Ask a few relatives to come at a time
choices.outcome_text: The visits stretched across several days. There was time to sit with each person, though the doorbell kept finding its moment.

choices.label: Wait a week before hosting visitors
choices.outcome_text: The first week stayed small and sleepy. Relatives sent messages and made plans to meet the baby later.

title: Another name for the baby
setup_text: An elder offers a family name for the baby. You both like the name you chose, and there is room for another.

choices.label: Add the family name
choices.outcome_text: The baby came to have another name and a story attached to it. The elder repeated both names slowly, as if learning a song.

choices.label: Keep the name you chose
choices.outcome_text: The name stayed as it was. The elder told its bearer the family story anyway, over a long phone call.

choices.label: Use the family name as a nickname
choices.outcome_text: The official name stayed, and another name began to travel around the family. Some people needed reminding which one to write down.

title: The song on the phone
setup_text: A grandparent sends a lullaby in a language neither of you speaks well. You want the baby to know it, but the words are unfamiliar.

choices.label: Learn the song from the recording
choices.outcome_text: The tune became familiar before the words did. Some evenings ended with the recording playing softly while everyone tried to follow along.

choices.label: Ask the grandparent to sing it live
choices.outcome_text: The phone became part of bedtime on some evenings. The song arrived with a familiar voice, even when the connection broke up.

choices.label: Make your own song for now
choices.outcome_text: A new little song found its way into the room. The recording stayed on the phone for a day when there was more time to learn it.

title: When work starts again
setup_text: Work is starting again. A relative offers daytime help at their home; a nearby carer has a place too. The journeys and costs are different.

choices.label: Accept the relative's offer
choices.outcome_text: The baby spent days with a familiar face. The longer trip became part of the family's morning rhythm.

choices.label: Choose the nearby carer
choices.outcome_text: The shorter journey gave the mornings some room. Getting to know a new carer took a little more time and money.

choices.label: Arrange a shorter work schedule for now
choices.outcome_text: The days were rearranged around shorter work hours. There was more time at home and less room in the budget.

title: The family group chat
setup_text: A relative asks for a photo of the baby to share in the family group. Some members live far away; others may pass pictures on.

choices.label: Share a photo with the group
choices.outcome_text: The group filled with greetings from people near and far. The photo travelled farther than the sitting room ever could.

choices.label: Send it to a few people privately
choices.outcome_text: A few relatives received the photo directly. It took more messages, but each one became a small conversation.

choices.label: Share an update without a photo
choices.outcome_text: The family heard how the baby was doing without a picture attached. A few people asked for a visit instead.

title: A warm evening
setup_text: The power is out on a warm evening. The baby is restless, and the family is deciding where to spend the next few hours.

choices.label: Sit together in the airy sitting room
choices.outcome_text: The family settled in the breezier room for a while. The evening routine started later, but the air felt easier.

choices.label: Visit a nearby relative for the evening
choices.outcome_text: The evening moved to a relative's house. There was company and a change of air, followed by a sleepy trip home.

choices.label: Keep the evening quiet at home
choices.outcome_text: The family stayed close to the usual routine, with fewer clothes and a cool drink for the grown-ups. It took a while for the house to settle.

title: A plate at the table
setup_text: Your toddler wants food from the family pot, but today's stew is hotter than the meals they know. Everyone is ready to eat.

choices.label: Make a milder portion from the same meal
choices.outcome_text: A small plate joined the others at the table. It took an extra pot, and there was plenty of pointing at everyone else's food.

choices.label: Offer a familiar meal alongside yours
choices.outcome_text: The familiar food arrived beside the family meal. Dinner was easier to serve, even as little hands reached towards other plates.

choices.label: Let them choose from the mild side dishes
choices.outcome_text: The side dishes got a great deal of attention. The meal looked different on one small plate, and there were more bowls to wash.

title: A greeting at the door
setup_text: An auntie arrives and waits for a greeting. Your toddler stays close to you, watching her from behind your leg.

choices.label: Greet her together and leave room to join
choices.outcome_text: The greeting began with the grown-ups. After a while, a small wave appeared from behind a leg.

choices.label: Offer a choice of wave or hello
choices.outcome_text: A wave became the greeting of the day. The auntie laughed and settled down to wait for the rest of the conversation.

choices.label: Give the greeting a little more time
choices.outcome_text: The visit began without a hello from the smallest person. By the time the plates came out, everyone had found a place in the room.

title: One more thing at the market
setup_text: At the market, your child spots a bright little ball. It was not on the list, and the money in your hand has other jobs today.

choices.label: Buy the ball and adjust the list
choices.outcome_text: The ball came home in the shopping bag, and one item waited for another day. It bounced across the floor before the bags were put away.

choices.label: Leave it and plan a treat another day
choices.outcome_text: The ball stayed at the stall. There was disappointment on the walk home, and later the family talked about what to save for.

choices.label: Look for a small ball within the budget
choices.outcome_text: A smaller ball made it into the bag after a little searching. The shopping took longer, and the list stayed mostly intact.

title: The red bucket
setup_text: A neighbour's child wants the red bucket your toddler is using. Both children reach for it, and play has come to a stop.

choices.label: Help them take turns with the bucket
choices.outcome_text: The bucket went back and forth with grown-up help. Waiting was not easy, but play had somewhere to go.

choices.label: Find another container for the game
choices.outcome_text: A plastic bowl joined the game. It took a little finding, and soon two sets of hands were busy filling and emptying.

choices.label: Let your child finish before offering it
choices.outcome_text: The neighbour waited while the bucket stayed in use. When it was finally free, the game picked up again in a different corner.

title: Saturday at Grandma's
setup_text: Grandma asks for a longer Saturday visit with your toddler. You have errands to do, and the usual nap falls in the middle of her plan.

choices.label: Visit for the whole afternoon
choices.outcome_text: The afternoon stretched over stories, food and a nap away from home. The errands had to wait for another time.

choices.label: Visit around the usual nap
choices.outcome_text: The visit was shorter, but the familiar nap stayed in place. Grandma packed a little food for the journey home.

choices.label: Invite Grandma to spend time at your home
choices.outcome_text: Grandma came over instead, bringing the visit into the usual Saturday routine. There was still a little tidying to do before she arrived.

title: The nursery down the road
setup_text: A nearby nursery has a place for your toddler. Your current care arrangement works, but the nursery offers a chance to play with other children.

choices.label: Try nursery for a few mornings
choices.outcome_text: A few mornings gained a new route and new faces. The rest of the week kept its familiar rhythm while everyone adjusted.

choices.label: Keep the current arrangement for now
choices.outcome_text: The days stayed familiar. The nursery kept its notice by the gate, and the family agreed to look again later.

choices.label: Visit the nursery before deciding
choices.outcome_text: The family spent a morning looking around and asking questions. The decision took longer, but the rooms were no longer a mystery.
